## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused unit tests added or updated where practical
- [ ] Java 25 `./gradlew test build` passes
- [ ] Relevant client, server, rendering, or multiplayer gate completed
- [ ] Fabric/NeoForge boundary considered
- [ ] Documentation updated with the behavior
- [ ] No credentials, runtime directories, account files, worlds, or generated packages included

## Topology and compatibility

State which coordinate domain is affected, whether protocol or saved-data
formats changed, and any known mod compatibility impact. Write `none` when a
category does not apply.
